title: Integral finiteness for the open-complement term of localization
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite intermediate extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $k$ be a field of prime characteristic different from $\ell$, and let $X$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. For any closed immersion $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion], put $j:U=X\setminus i(Z)\hookrightarrow X$. In the ordinary derived category of modules over the pulled-back condensed ring $\mathcal O_E$ [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], the finite-constant-model bounded constructible class $\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E)$ [sk-def-sfb-constructible] is triangulated [def-weil-triangulated-subcategory], and $Rj_*j^*K$ belongs to that class for every $K$ in it.

source.place: Localization paragraph, third-term constructibility; DAG steps 1 and 4--6

proof.text: X is Noetherian by local finite type over the field and quasi-compactness. The open complement j is quasi-compact; the composite structure map makes U a separated finite-type k-scheme. These instances include empty schemes and the empty open.

Apply the integral constant-model heart closure theorem in exactly the padicIntegersRingObj coefficient presentation. Construct the zero local model as the cokernel of the identity on rank-zero free modules, on the identity cover and single stratum. Isomorphism invariance transports local models. The general weak Serre homology-property theorem gives triangulation after intersecting with boundedness, exactly generators.

IntegralModelsOperations(1) gives j^*K in the constant-model bounded constructible class. The equality Dctf=Dbc for the actual padicIntegersRingObj coefficient gives finite Tor amplitude. Apply integralOpenDirectImage, the open clause of sk-thm-sf-pf-adic, to this object. Its constructibility conclusion is Rj_*j^*K in generators. All functors are exactly the given upperStar and lowerStar derived functors; no coefficient transport is used.

proof_origin.place: Localization paragraph, with direct weak Serre triangulation and the existing exact-coefficient open theorem; fully formalized by U3

theorem integralComplementFiniteness
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ)
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    {Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] :
    (generators (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) X).IsTriangulated ∧
      ∀ K, generators (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) X K →
        generators (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) X
          (((upperStar (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val)
            i.openComplement.ι).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
              (lowerStar (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val)
                i.openComplement.ι).rightDerivedFunctor).obj K)
